ROUND 2 key correction: the court is a HIGH PLATEAU and its FRONT and BACK EDGES MUST BE IN FRAME, with a deep dark lavender/violet faceted cliff face plunging below the front lip into luminous warm peach cloud. The court cannot fill the image; ground takes roughly the MIDDLE 55-60% of frame, environment/cloud/cliff together 40-45%. Camera is still the shipped 58 degree downward match angle, lane left-to-right, moved a little higher/back so the court reads smaller and the z=+-13 borders fit. This is a gameplay camera, not a cinematic low-angle view or a fully zoomed-out map diagram. Large combat units stay readable. Do not preserve round one's all-floor crop.
Lighting/depth: one LOW WARM SUN from upper left. Warm creamy-peach highlights on top/left facets opposed to COOL VIOLET shaded facets and printed directional shadow ellipses. Cliff at least 30% darker than floor. Front court is crisp, strongly separated from dark cliff. Below and behind, contrast and saturation recede progressively into warm glowing peach/cream haze: broad soft cloud banks and one or two tall stone isles/ruined arch silhouettes, hazy, no fine detail. A little diffuse cream light blooms IN THE HAZE ONLY, never on the playable court or combat. Distant pale moon very faint and optional in the outer upper sky crop, not a large golden sun/face. White/lilac waterfall ribbons falling from exterior edges into mist, never saturated blue. No roads, bridges or connections to other islands.
Palette: muted pale SAGE-BUTTER court (far less bright yellow than round one), sage rim moss, warm pale stone tops, dusty lavender stone, cool violet cliff/shadows, peach/cream sky and haze. Team BLUE and RED, and GOLD BALL, are the ONLY saturated colours. No gold shield bosses or ornamental jewels. Court one QUIET uniform flat fill, no busy grass, mottled watercolour, paving grids, floor cracks, highlights, bloom or texture noise. Stone inlays at most 8% darker, unoutlined, never white chalk. Moss and sparse simple apricot plants only on exterior rim, not on court or obstacle cover. Navy ink thick on combat units/structures; thin on vertical cliff silhouette/scenery; NONE on court, sky/cloud. Big shapes, little noise.
EXACT MAP: single continuous LONG isle 104x26m, x lane horizontal, blue base left, red right. Walkable footprint remains |x|<=52, |z|<=13, base walls |x|>28 and |z|>8. ONE 12m lane, two 5m flanks z=+-10.5, no second lane or disconnected floating segments. Four low long cover blocks at x=+-18,z=+-7, spanning x=+-12..24; preserve 1.2m height. Four midfield pillars x=+-4.5,z=+-4, same positions/heights/collision radii; two extra pillars x=-13,z=-3 and x=13,z=3. ONE tower each side at x=+-18,z=0, ONE core each at x=+-40,z=0. No forts or castle buildings. All existing cover gaps, tower/core spacing and combat routes must remain. Rim chips decorative, do not carve notches into the walkable rectangle. The centre circle radius9 is a VERY faint inlay and Ball cue, no strong printed sports markings.
